kubernetes.compatibility: kind v0.33.0 emits kubeadm v1beta4 for Kubernetes >=1.36, required by this profile's bootstrap timeout patch. kubectl v1.35 is within the supported one-minor skew.

smoke.source: Existing verified Python rootfs image digest; docker image inspect must confirm the same digest before local preload.

scope: Trusted ordinary Job lifecycle only; no gVisor, Kueue or performance acceptance yet. The node image pins containerd transitively; its observed version is recorded from Kubernetes Node status.
